backlog.title: How Markiplier Made a Movie Hollywood Couldn’t Ignore
backlog.author: Colin and Samir
backlog.raw_text:
Markipliers voice is so good. 

THANKS YOUTUBE FOR SPONSORING OUR EVENT. 

Today on The Colin & Samir Show we sit down with Markiplier and YouTube's Tim Katz, live from the Fox Studios lot in front of 650 creators at Press Publish LA: The Hollywood Creator Summit.
After more than 15 years building one of YouTube's most personal channels, Markiplier put Hollywood on notice with Iron Lung, the horror film he financed, wrote, directed, and starred in. The film pulled in close to $52 million in theaters and is now on YouTube. We get into why he treated a feature film like a YouTube video, what he learned leading a hundred-person crew, why he stays his own harshest critic, and how he sees this collision of YouTube and Hollywood playing out for creators.

backlog.hook: Markiplier financed, directed and starred in a $52M feature film, then released it on YouTube instead of keeping it in theaters—treating a Hollywood production like a YouTube video.

backlog.title: YouTube Partner Program Changes - Explained!
backlog.author: Creator Insider
backlog.raw_text:

Creator Insider Rene Ritchie sits down with YouTube VP of Creator Product, Amjad Hanif, to break down all the updates and dive into why YPP needs new entry thresholds and a new 10M Shorts baseline, the brand-new creator incentive programs, and the continued partnership between YouTube and creators

backlog.title: Changes to the YouTube Partner Program & New Ways to Earn
backlog.author: Creator Insider
backlog.raw_text:
YouTube is updating the YouTube Partner Program. Including revenue sharing for Premium Lite, new Shorts incentives, and updated YPP entry thresholds for ads and premium revenue sharing

Since the YouTube Partner Program launched, the ecosystem has grown massively. There are so many more creators, channels, and formats. And so much more content. To make sure YPP scales, remains sustainable, provides  investment in new creator incentives, and continues to reward active engagement in meaningful ways, YouTube is introducing three updates that will take effect on February 1, 2027

3:23 - Next Steps for Creators
backlog.hook: YouTube is changing YPP entry thresholds, Premium Lite revenue splits, and Shorts incentives effective February 2027 — official platform mechanism changes.

backlog.title: Collabs on YouTube - How to Grow Views & Subs
backlog.author: Creator Insider
backlog.raw_text:
If you’ve already used collabs - YouTube's feature that lets creators jump into each other's channels - you know that the video shows up on the host's channel but puts collaborators' branding right on the player, shows up in everyone’s subs feeds, makes everyone’s audience available for potential recommendations, and - optionally - lets everyone see the analytics

But creators still have questions about collabs, and here as some answers straight from YouTube!

backlog.hook: YouTube's official answers on how collabs affect video performance, channel size requirements, and upcoming changes to the feature.
